headline: Jamaat leader arrested for attempted rape of woman
summary: The suspect allegedly lured the woman under the pretext of providing a spiritual amulet before attempting to assault her.
details: A Jamaat-e-Islami leader has been arrested following allegations of attempted rape of a woman.
The suspect reportedly lured the victim by claiming he would provide her with a 'tabiz' or spiritual amulet.
According to reports, the man attempted to sexually assault the woman after gaining her trust through the promise of spiritual healing.
Law enforcement authorities took the suspect into custody following the complaint filed by the victim.

headline: Female prisoner missing from Kashimpur Women's Central Jail
summary: A case has been filed at the local police station following the disappearance of a female inmate from the facility.
details: A female prisoner has gone missing from the Kashimpur Women's Central Jail in Gazipur.
Following the discovery of the disappearance, a case has been filed at the local police station to initiate a formal investigation.
Authorities are now working to determine how the inmate managed to escape or disappear from the high-security facility.
The incident has raised concerns regarding the security protocols at the women's prison.
